tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bdag 'jug gi cho ga bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing*/ dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// mdog dang dbyibs sogs spros pa med kyang sku dang rnam 'phrul kun 'phrul zhing*// brjod dang brjod bya'i tshul las 'das kyang tshig dang dbyangs kyis kun ston la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog spangs kyang mkhyen dang brtse ba'i thugs gsal ba'i// lha dang bla ma gnyis su med kyang gnyis dang du mar ston la 'dud// lung dang rjes su gdams pa'i tshul bzhin 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bskur ba// gzhung dang nyams su blang ba'i rim bzhin grub pa'i skyes bu mchog rnams kyis// yang dang yang du gsal bar mdzad bzhin bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga'i rim// dad dang 'dun pas bskul ba'i ngag bzhin bdag gis 'dir ni gsal bar bshad// de la dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing rim pa gnyis la gnas pa bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis/ sdom pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa dag cing*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'dod pas 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun sum tshogs la rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i sa'i cha sngar yongs su ma sbyangs par sa'i cho ga bya ste/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gcig bshams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir ba byung dang dri bzangs kyis byugs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī zhes pas me tog gi tshom bu bkod la sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing bdag la phyogs par bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐ bkod nas/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag la ham̐ dmigs te/

sa la gtugs pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa tshom bu la bstim ste/ dbang bskur nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyi'i mchod rdzas rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī gṛhṇa dam̐ zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstshā swā hā/ la sogs pa so so'i sngags kyis phul nas/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyis sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len par 'tshal bas/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing*/ las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin zhing dpang po mdzad par bsams nas/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas de nyid du thim par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su langs la/ rdo rje dril bu dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pas/ mig g.yas g.yon gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi zla hūm̐ gis mtshan par dmigs la g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs rnams tshar bcad pa dang*/ g.yon nas g.yas su blta bas rjes su gzung bar sems la/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyi/ lha dang*/

klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za mo dang*/ srin po la sogs pa gang dag 'dir gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du song shig 'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' nos nas myur ba nyid du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dis spyi bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod pas dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang ba'i nag po'i phyogs rnams bskrad cing*/ dkar po'i phyogs snod du gyur pa rnams zhi ba'i yid kyis bdag gis grogs byed par bsam mo// sa bslang ba'o// de nas lto 'phye'i lto ba'i phyogs nas pus mo nub tsam du brkos te gyo mo dang sol ba dang*/ rus bu la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyung nas/ dri bzangs dang*/ rin po che dang bcas pa'i sa brnyan bzang pos bkang zhing 'thas par brdungs la/ shar dang byang du gzhol zhing me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'i sa stegs gru bzhi pa byas pa'i steng dang khor yug kun tu lag pa gnyis bzhag cing*/ oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes brjod pas phyogs thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du bltas nas sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar byas la srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms te bgegs tshar bcad pa rnams sgrub thabs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// sa sbyang zhing bsrung ba'o// de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis byang shar du song la/ sngar bzhin du bgegs la bka' bsgos nas/ g.yon skor gyis bskor zhing shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub du sa ga byang du zlum po la sogs pa'i rkang stabs kyi bkod pa rnams kyis sa gzung ba bya ba'am ma grub kyang 'gal ba med la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs la sems can thams cad kyi don bya snyam du yid kyis gzung ngo*// sa bzung ba ste sa'i cho ga'o// de nas sta gon la 'jug pa'i tshe ba byung dang dri bzangs kyis byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lngas bskor zhing*/

gos zung*/ ku sha nang mchod/ gtor ma/ rdo rje/ dril bu la sogs pa rnams bsags nas/ phyi ma red kyi tshe/ sgrub pa po'i grogs dang bcas pa rim gyis 'khod la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis der 'dus pa'i 'byung po rnams la bsngos nas/ snod ma yin pa bskrad cing*/ snod dang ldan pa rnams la grogs bcol la/ gnas dang yo byad rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rol mo'i sgra cher byas la/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi'i sngags brjod do// de nas las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs la bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ mchod pa bzlas pa'i bar rdzogs par byas nas/ bdag nyid phyag gnyis par bsdus te/ mchod rdzas sumbhas bsang zhing swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las ā las ka pā la dpag tu med pa mchod rdzas rnams kyis gang bas sa dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ bar snang thams cad gang bar bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sa bslang ba'i skabs ltar sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ba byung dri bzangs bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba blugs pa rnal 'byor pas dbang ldan nas g.yon skor du khyem med par byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badzrī bha wa bandha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms la/ oṃ sumbha rā dza badzra kro dha tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis dbus su phur ba btab la/ gnod mdzes nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang*/ oṃ ka ni ru ni badzra kro dha tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa dang*/ oṃ nī la daṇḍa badzra kro dha tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub tu dbyug pa sngon po can dbyug pa 'dzin pa dang*/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa badzra kro dha tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/

nub byang du rta mgrin dmar po padma'i dbyug to 'dzin pa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li badzra kro dha maṇḍa la tsakra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon/ g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bskyed nas/ de dag la tsandan dmar po'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu dang gu gul gyi bdug pas mchod la bsrung ba mdzad par gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rten gyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gis mos pa la lha dang*/ thod pa dang dur khrod kyi gnas rnams su me tog gi tshom bu bkod la lha so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis lha dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// dur khrod kyi gnas rnams su skad cig gis bskyed nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa la/ sngags dang phyi'i mchod pa'i mthar lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos zung lha re re la'ang dpag tu med pa phul bar bsam zhing*/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa'i mthar/ badzra wast+rā ya āḥzhes pas gos zung sbyar bas mchod la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /bdag cag la bgegs med par mdzod// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol swā hā// zhes pas ku sha'i chun po brgyad phyogs shar nas g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams me nas g.yas skor gyis dbul lo// de nas mchod pa'i cho ga ltar yid las byung ba nas gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// lha lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas bum pa bsangs te/

sbyangs pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan zhing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa g.yogs par bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par skad cig gis 'khor lo lnga'i gdan bskyed pa'i steng du/ mngon byang lnga las lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ mngon byang las bde ba chen po'i lha lnga bskyed/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs pa la/ mchod cing bstod nas rang gi snying gi hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas/ lha so so'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par yab yum gyi nye snying dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags dang*/ las thams cad pa la sumbha ni dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas la slar mchod cing bstod nas/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i chur blta'o// bum pa sta gon no// de nas yul gyi bya ba rnams gtso bo dang*/ bla ma tha mi dad kyis mdzad par bsam zhing*/ rang dang 'brel pa rnams bdag nyid kyis byas par bsams nas/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas 'di las gzhan// bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa bskyed nas rang nyid bla ma'i zhal du zhugs pa'i thugs kar ye shes kyi mes 'od du zhu ba'i byang chub sems kyi thig ler gyur pa yum gyi mkhar babs pa las byung ba'i he ru ka yab yum yan lag bzhi rdzogs su tshang bar byas nas/

sbyor mtshams sam yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas bton pa bdag nyid kyis gnas su 'khod par bsams nas/ maṇḍal phul la dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ bla mas bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyis// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs pas spro ba bskyed nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa yul du dmigs te// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu dag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// zhes lan gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems dang dam tshig blang*/

rang skad cig gis dpal he ru kar dmigs pa'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i phyag rgya gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du mos nas/ bla ma'i srin lag las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir dmigs pa'i thig le bkod pas bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab bo// de la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bsams la dngos su'ang mchod pa lngas mchod do// de nas gser las byas par mos pa'i so shing gi rtse mos so brud cing*/ blad la sdig pa thams cad skyugs par bsams nas/ tshom bu gcig pa'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su dor ba'i rtse mo bstan pa'i phyogs kyis dngos grub rnams shes par byas nas/ yi ge bdun pas bsngags pa'i skyor chu 'thungs pas nang gi dri ma sbyangs la/ lus kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po sum sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu bstim pas dpung pa g.yon par bcing zhing yi ge bdun pa brjod pas bsrung ba'o// de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo bas// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyi// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pas spro ba brtan par byas nas/

dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha sngas dang stan gyi phyir blangs la/ tshogs kyi 'khor los phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod do// lhag ma'i cho ga byas la/ 'das pa'i gtor ma ma gtogs pa rnams btang nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim nas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsdus la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// sta gon no// nang par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshul/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ltar shes par byas la/ 'dir ras bris la brten pa'i tshul ni/ phyi ma red gyi tshe/ tshom bu'i gzhi de nyid la ba byung lnga dri bzangs bdud rtsi dang bcas pas legs par byugs pa'i steng du gzhi bzang po bting ba la/ dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shar phyogs su zhal bstan nas bkram la/ khor yug kun tu mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bsham mo// de nas sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ oṃ sarba bi ghnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te la sogs pas der 'dus pa'i bgegs rnams la gtor ma lan gsum byin nas/ bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig ces brjod pa zhi ba dang*/ sumbha'i sngags brjod cing ting lo dang chang bu byin nas bskrad pa zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs kar gyis brabs la/ sumbha la sogs pa drag po'i sngags brjod nas/ gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag gi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gags par bya'o// zhes brjod pa drag po 'ba' zhig gis bgegs sbyangs nas/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kaṃ gi rnam pas sna bug nas 'thon pa g.yas su ye shes kyi me dang*/ g.yon du rgya mtshor dor bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarb+ba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṅku ru swā hā/ zhes yang yang brjod pas sdig pa sbyangs shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyis tshon dang 'bags btsog la sogs pa sbyang ba'i phyir me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags kyi mthar chu'i rdul bsal bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya bi sho dha no swā hā/ zhes brjod do// dar la sogs pas phyis pas dri ma sbyangs/ de nas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od las srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed pa'i nang du lam̐ las sa/ bam̐ las chu/ ram̐ las me/ yam̐ las rlung*/ sum̐ las ri rab/ thig le ser pos mtshan pa rnams 'dres pa las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa bzhin gdan rnams dang bum pa brgyad dang bcas zhing dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba bskyed la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis reg nas pū dza la sogs pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas lha'i gnas rnams su mngon byang sum cu rtsa bdun las lha rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi bskyed la/ go cha gnyis bcings nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rang la bstim pa/ mdun du phyung ba la mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun bskyed la bstim mo// slar yang ye shes pa bstim zhing dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dbyu gu'i rtser rdo rje btags pas lha rnams la reg cing thog mar gtso bo yab yum la snying po gnyis dang lha gzhan rnams la rang sngags dang thod pa bzhi dang dur khrod rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de bzhin du gnyis pa la yum gyi nye snying dang*/

gsum pa la sgo ma bzhi'i phreng sngags dang*/ bzhi pa la ā li dang*/ lnga pa la kā li dang*/ drug pa la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing byin gyin brlab bo// dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// de nas sngags kyi mchod pa nas brtsams te mchod pa rgyas pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar bya ba ni mchod pa'o// de nas rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du song nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug la bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mdun du dbang blangs te/ bla mas mdzad rgyu rnams des mdzad la/ las kyi bya ba rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas mdzad cing slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis dngos su bya'o// de'ang maṇḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba la/ bla mas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod nas a kham̐ wi ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing me tog gi phreng ba gtad las thams cad pa'i chu dang sumbhas bsangs/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes pa dang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan btab nas/ rang gi snying gi nang du kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsams nas/ dngos su rdo rjes gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsi tta utpa da yā mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/

zhes pas byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ spyi bor rdo rje gtugs la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ sgo mas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du khrid par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod do// phyi'i 'jug pa'o// //de nas rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par mos nas go cha gnyis bcings la gtso bo dang lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya sbrel nas rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma hi/ bi dyā rā dzā ya dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes brjod pas bskul lo// de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pas bla ma dang*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la skyabs su song nas/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs gcod mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag la grub par mdzod// ces pas gsol ba gdab pa rnams lan gsum du bya'o// de nas bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab par bsam mo// de nas rang gi bgegs dang sdig pa dang*/ dri ma sbyangs nas/ swa bhā was mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/

mngon par byang chub pa lnga'am/ rang skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la/ go cha bcings nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ā li dang kā li'i rnam pas bdag la thim zhing bla mas ā li kā li brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bsgom pa ni nang du 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar thal mo sbyar zhing*/ na masti hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rkang pa re brjod pa dang*/ phyag re 'tshal zhing bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bar bsam mo// de nas 'jug pa'i don du rnal 'byor pas shar sgo nas rang mkha' 'gro mar dmigs te/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza u pastha nā ya ādma naṃ niryā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ādma ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣṭha swa māṃ zhes pa dang*/ byang nas lā mār dmigs te dpral bar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya ādma naṃ niryā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ādma lā mā a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes pa dang*/ nub nas khaṇḍa ro hār dmigs te/ mgrin par thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza pra warta nā ya ādma naṃ niryā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ādma khaṇḍa ro hā dharmā tsakra wart+ta na ya māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ lho nas gzugs can mar dmigs te/ spyi gtsug tu thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza karmā ṇi ādma naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ādma rū pi nī karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag re re bya'o// de nas rang nyid shar sgor 'dug pa la bla mas/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin// zhes dam tshig spyir bsgrags pa dang*/

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re zhing yang lan drug tu// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus kyis// zhes pas dam tshig so sor bsgrags nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la// la sogs pa bdag nyid kyis lan gsum brjod pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa spyi dang sngar bshad pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyang blang ngo*// de ltar thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung du gzhug pa'i phyir/ bla mas ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang*/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mri ta ud ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūm̐/

zhes brjod nas bdud rtsi blud pa phan yon dang*/ nyes dmigs gnyis ka dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod mi bdai ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag cing bdag gis bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs par bsam mo// de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab bo// de nas dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pa'i ngang las rang nyid yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor has mtshan pa'i steng na gnas pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad nas bzhengs pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin/ sum mdor ram̐ las me gru gsum/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu dkar po zlum po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung zla gam has mtshan pa dmigs nas 'og gi rlung g.yos pas dzhaieṃ 'bar ba'i me sum mdo'i me dang 'dres pa'i me lces lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsreg sa dmar por tshig chu bskol bas 'og dang steng gi rlung gis bteg cing mnan/ me'i 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad char bzhin du babs pas lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su gu gul la sogs pas bdug bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he bidyā rā dzā ya dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes bsgrags par bsam zhing yid gzung ngo*// de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas tiṣṭha badzras brtan par mdzad par bsam/

ye shes dbab pa'o// de nas bla mas/ lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum gyis lha la gsol ba btab nas/ rang gis me tog bzung nas dkyil 'khor la bltas pa'i kha dog sna tshogs pas las gang 'grub rtags la/ oṃ pa tītstsha badzra hoḥs sngar phog pa'i lha la me tog dbul lo// de nas pra ti gṛhṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes gsung zhing me tog mgor bzhag nas rang gi mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ bskyed la he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ni tra ā pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥzhes pas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub khyod kun mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis// zhes pas dkyil 'khor spyi dang*/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar bzhugs// gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas// brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyin can// spyod dang grol bar rab brtson pa// kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste// dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos// zhes pas gtso bo lhag par bstan nas/ rang gis kyang blta zhing dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos su mthong snyam du nges shes skyes pa ni nang du 'jug pa ste/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// //de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol zhig

/ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rin po che'i khri padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dpal he ru kar dmigs pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po dang phyogs thams cad nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par bsam zhing gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs thams cad bskrad/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ bkra shis brjod cing khrus gsol te/ me tog gi char chen po phab pas shis pa mdzad par bsam mo// de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rang gi snying gar zhugs nas snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas/ sngags kyi dbang thams cad thob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ shri badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod nas me tog slar phul/ gtso bos phreng ba de nyid sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsung zhing me tog spyi bor bzhag par bsam pa ni sngags kyi dbang ngo*// de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga blang ba'i phyir bdag dang rnam rgyal gyi bum pa swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus pas mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐ bkod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bltas la/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis nam mkhar byon nas gtso bos/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ṭa'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ kā kā sye/ u lū kā sye/ shwa nā sye/ sū ka rā sye/ ya ma da dhī/ ya ma dū tī/ ya ma daṃ ṣṭ+ri' ṇī/ ya ma mā tha nī/ oṃ badzrī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing mchod nas dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa ni phyi'i dbang ngo*// snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs pa snying ga'i sgo nas lus la thim pas/ bdag mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur pa ni nang gi dbang ngo*// de nas dngos su mchod nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang rnam par dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// 'od kyi spro bsdu las bskyed pa dang*/ dbang rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ yum rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ gnyis ka'i rgyan dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa da nga*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rdzogs pas dbang gi las mdzad pa rnams ni/ dbang 'og ma rnams la'ang so sor sbyar zhing shes par bya'o// ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rin chen sgrol ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas/ dbang gis lhas/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gis brgyan pa'i// rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes pa'i mthar yum gyi nye snying dang*// oṃ pra tītstsha ma hā mu ku ṭa ho/

zhes pas dbu rgyan dang*/ chu la sogs pas sngar bzhin du dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan nas dpral ba'i am̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dpral ba nas lus la thim pas/ rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas/ cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid dang rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo// //dzrīṃ las padma dzrīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum gos dkar mo dang sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod ni dbang bskur te// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣṭha bī ra sa mā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje gnang ba blangs te/ snying gar bzung ba la chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan nas/ mgrin pa'i dzrīṃ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa mgrin pa nas lus la thim pas rang nyid 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// //khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// badzra ghaṇḍe aḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dril bu gnang ba lag pa g.yon pas dkrol la/

chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan nas mtshog ma'i kham̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad don yod grub pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa mtshog ma nas lus la thim pas/ rang nyid don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa dang*/ don yod grub pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// //bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes dbang bskur te/ 'di la dbang rdzas med do// yang chu la sogs pas dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan nas spyi bo'i bhrūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa spyi bo nas lus thams cad la thim pas/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod nas/ ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings dang rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo// rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// //de nas padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas/ dbang gi lhas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭha badzra e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra yā mi hūm̐ hi hi hi hi hoḥzhes pas rdo rje gnang ba snying gar bzung la/

snying gi nang du yang de lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// yang padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru// he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// zhes pas g.yas pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yos pas thod pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga se ral khar tshangs pa'i skud pas bcings nas snying gi nang du yang de lta bu'i he ru ka bsgom pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs te slob ma'i dbang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal phul la/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdo rje slob dpon bdag gyur mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du gsol ba btab nas/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri seng ges bteg pa padma dang nyi mar mos pa'i steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par gyur pa la/ go cha gnyis bcings te/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// la sogs pa sngags dang bcas pas lag pa g.yas par rdo rje byin nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag

/ces de kho na nyid gsungs shing dran pas rang gi sems thugs rdo rje dang*/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma la sogs pas dril bu g.yon du byin nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes de kho na nyid gsung zhing dran pas rang gi sems gsung rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bshad// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing de'i don rang gis dran par byas pas lus sku rdo rjer gyur pa la snga ma bzhin bum pa'i chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag slob dpon gyi bya ba mtha' dag la dbang bar byas nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gi char phab pas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// //de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis bzhed pa yin// sems can rnams ni rjes gzung phyir// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// zhes slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rjes gnang dang*/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*// shes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyis// gar mchod bde ba'i dga' sngon gyis// āḥs sgeg mo dang*/

sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma// des ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ gyis phreng ba ma dang*/ lus can rnams la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis// des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gīs glu ma dang*/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis// hoḥs gar ma dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// āḥs bdug pa ma dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bhrūm̐ gyis me tog ma dang*/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// padma gar dbang rang nyid de// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis// pras mar me ma dang*/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams labasgos// gas dri chab ma ste/ mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥpraṃ/ zhes pas thur ma dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// des na rnal 'byor ma sras skye// zhes pas me long ste sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang dang*/

sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten du ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes pas 'khor lo dang*/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med par// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// zhes pas dung ste/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// gsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni grub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste// rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni// de ni ci dgar grub par gyis// zhes pas phrin las te/ rjes su gnang ba rnams so// de nas dam tshig la gnyis las/ dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid// ma lus par ni byas gyur kyang*// bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa'i// sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*// lus dang srog la ltos med par// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re zhing ni bzlas par bya// gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bsrung ba ni// gnyis med gnyis med la gnas pa// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma bgom par mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// bud med thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*// spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// bdag ni ma khyod bu yin te// ji srid byang chub byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i// bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas// sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung*// dam tshig de la rtag gnas te// de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid// spyod dang grol ba'i gnad 'dod pa'i// yid la 'dod pa kun grub 'gyur// zhes bla mas dam tshig dang sdom pa gnang ba la/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes rang gis sgrub par khas blangs nas/ gnyis pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig bkas gnang ba la gnyis las/ spyod pa dang*/ thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la// 'dod pa lnga la spyod par gyis// gnyis med la gnas zas la ni// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas// gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa// dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa yin// sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing*// tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no// khro ba med pa'i rgyun bcad pa'i// sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung*// rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni// yul kun la ni rnal 'byor ma'i// gnyis med bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o// mi brtan srog ni ji srid par// bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che// bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do// zhes pa dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no// zhes pa rnams dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa'o// de nas bla mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas gtugs nas/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin// mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis// 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dngos grub mchog tu grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// he badzra aṃ ku ri/ shrī he ru ka che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhūrbhu wa swaḥ

gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzad do// zhes pas lung bstan zhing gzengs bstod nas/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang*// der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin// dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis kyang*// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis// brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin// zhes pas dbugs phyung bar bsam mo// de nas me tog yon du dmigs te phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gtang rag dbul lo// phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ gnyis su med pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug pa zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/

gsang ba'i gnas nas thig le'i rnam par babs pas bdag gi lce thog tu gnang bar bsam zhing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro// 'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor// khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can// he ru ka dpal bdag sbyor bas// yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis// zhes gsungs nas gnang ba lce la myangs pas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags nas gsung rnam par dag pa/ 'od dpag tu med par gyur par bsgoms la/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs phye nas/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇḍā lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ tshig snga ma nyid kyis gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs te/ 'bru gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog phyag bcu gnyis par dmigs la bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// 'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor// khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can// he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas// yang dag bde ba myong bar gyis// deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis// bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar skyes dag spyod cig /padma'i bha gar tsumba dang*// bdud rtsi rnams ni legs grub kyis// zhes gsung zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i phyag rgya byin nas lha mo des/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun// gus dang bcas par mchod pa dang*// gnyis med tshul gyis tsumba na// dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam// smros shig dpa' bo bde ba che// bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// zhes phyag rgyas dris pa'i lan du/

ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni// lha mo bdag gis byed par nus// zhes lan gdab pa dang*/ de pang du byon pa rdo rje phag mor gsal bar dmigs te/ sku gsung thugs dang gnas lnga dang*// mkha' dang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pas snyoms par zhugs pas 'khyud pa dang*/ tsumba'i tshe/ sna tshogs pa la dga' ba/ mnyam par sbyar ba'i tshe rnam smin la mchog dga'/ spyod pa dang ldan pa'i tshe rnam nyid la dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ bde stong zung du chud pa'i tshe mtshan nyid dang bral ba la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam/ de nyid kyi tshe yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul nas/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs te/ lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcas pa la bla mas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// zhes gsungs pa'i don dran par byas nas/ de la yid mnyam par gzhag la chos kyi sku'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo// de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma thams cad dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/

ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo// dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas lus dang longs spyod thams cad yon du phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te la sogs pa gtang rag 'bul lo// de nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ lhag gtor bkra shis dang bcas pa'i bar cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin byas nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bsngo ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang brjod do// //dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i lha tshogs rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol nas/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas btang ste/ bdag nyid kyi cho ga gsum gyis bsrungs la/ las kyi rjes bsdus nas/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// de ltar rgyu'i dbang rtag tu lam du byed pa ni/ sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs shing*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad la longs spyod de/ ring por mi thogs par dbang phyug brgyad kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do//
